name: Mashiro Kanoe
source:
"Whether you are alive or dead, I still love you." 

Genius x Self-Harm

Heroine's junior who is also part of health committee. He's unethusiastic and always speaks in monotone manner.

For some reasons, he's often misses school. Even when he attends school, he spends most of his time in the infirmary.
Despite being only a first year student, he managed to develop a famous app that unveils his genius side.
